cases.name: Chelsea King
cases.about:
She was a senior at Poway High School.

Chelsea's Law, which was introduced by Assemblymen Nathan Fletcher, was passed. The bill, designed to help prevent similar crimes in the future, was signed into California state law by then-Gov. Arnold Schwarzenegger on September 9, 2010. As signed, Chelsea's Law mandates that some of the worst child molester offenders face lifetime prison sentences - a punishment previously reserved in California for murderers. In addition, some paroled child molesters deemed at risk of re-offending are barred from parks.
cases.narrative: On 3/2/2010, FBI divers found her body buried in a shallow grave on the southeast corner of the Lake Hodges' inlet, where some of her clothes had been found. On 2/25/2010, Chelsea disappeared while she was jogging in the early evening at the Rancho Bernardo Community Park, near Lake Hodges.
